notes: - **With a graphics card, the live transcript can run on your PC and keep up: free and private, while your notes still use the service you chose.** **Live transcript by** now lists each speech model on your PC that keeps up with a meeting, by name and where it runs (**Whisper Large v3 Turbo · graphics card**, **Parakeet V2 · processor**), and Automatic takes the fastest, a graphics card first. A model on the card is timed on the card, its live lines are cut into shorter pieces so they appear sooner, and if the card gives out mid-meeting the processor finishes the piece and the window says so. The Savings tab shows what your month would be with the live transcript on your card. See [Live on your graphics card](/docs/live-window/#live-on-your-graphics-card).
